description.zh: 俯视视角的平面足球场。球摆在下方中央，按住球拖向球门方向、松手射门，拖得越远力量越大。球门每一脚都换到随机位置，五脚定胜负，看看你能进几个！
description.en: A top-down 2D pitch. The ball sits at the bottom centre — drag it toward the goal and release to shoot; the longer the drag, the harder the strike. The goal moves to a random spot every shot. Five attempts per round — how many can you score?

controls.zh: 按住球拖向球门方向瞄准，松手射门（拖得越远力量越大），Esc / P 暂停
controls.en: Drag the ball toward the goal and release to shoot (longer drag = more power), Esc / P to pause
